name: wooden farm fence piece 'v' (slim posts with cap tops, two rails)

answer.evidence: The vertical fence piece is drawn flat without visible top surfaces on its rails or beams; the 1px light rows at row 0, 6, and 12 are edge highlights, not foreshortened horizontal surfaces.

answer.main_body: fence post and vertical rail section
answer.evidence: The post cap shows a clear foreshortened top surface spanning rows 0-3 (4 source pixels tall) with top-down lighting and shading, correctly displaying 3/4 perspective rather than a flat front view.
The vertical fence post on the right features a clearly rendered top cap surface occupying rows 0-3 (4 rows tall) viewed from above in 3/4 perspective, transitioning to the front shaft below.

The fence shows an isometric receding side face in columns 8-10 with a diagonally sloped top cap (rows 0-3) and shaded side surface (rows 4-14) alongside the front face, violating the south-facing 3/4 camera view with no receding side faces.
